Like other event maps, this map had a specialized wave structure with special enemies. Players started with a varying amount of cash, based on how many players there were in the match. The rewards you received were based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. This map had two difficulties, Easy and Hard. Cash was only gained if an enemy is killed, or in some cases, damaged by a specific amount of health. Additionally, the amount gained was a set amount of cash, which was not always equal to the enemy's health. In solo, you received 100% of the cash when an enemy was killed, or it was damaged enough. With each additional player, this decreased by 25%, which means that in a trio, you only got 50% of the cash. This amount was distributed between players based on how much damage they dealt. However, if a player did not deal any damage, they would receive a percentage of the enemy's full cash upon its death or when it was damaged enough, which was 12.5% in duo and 16.7% in trio. If it was a decimal, it gets rounded up or down depending on the decimal value. If it was at least 0.5, it got rounded up. If it was less than 0.5, it got rounded down. For example, the [[Withered (Hexscape)|Withered]] gave {{Money|1,000}} after losing 25% of its health in solo, {{Money|750}} in duo and {{Money|500}} in trio between the players that damaged it. Players that did not damage it received {{Money|125}} in duo and {{Money|167}} in trio. Health of enemies in this mode scaled with player count. The increase was 10% more health in duo and 20% more health in trio. The first increase was not always the same amount, while the second increase had a varied amount it increases health by. Both increases were affected by enemy health. This map had the [[HP Locked]] modifier, which set the base health to 100, the [[Blood]] modifier, which made enemies have a blood effect when killed, the [[Farm Banned]] modifier, which prohibited [[Farm]]s from generating cash. Additionally, on the Hard difficulty, the [[Cowboy]] and [[Golden Cowboy]] got their cash generation halved, and the [[Gatling Gun Banned]] modifier was added, which removed the [[Gatling Gun]] from loadouts of players. This map featured three bosses, being [[Corrupted Titus]], [[Corrupted Conserver (Hexscape)|Corrupted Conserver]] and the final boss, [[Primordial Drakobloxxer]]. ==Design & Path== '''Containment''' took place in a giant crater, which before its creation was a village. Remnants of civilization could be found around the map, with broken tracks, burned down houses and skeletons, and random objects like planks that were scattered around the map. Multiple rocks and cliffs could be found inside the crater. There was also a large portal to [[The Nightmare Realm]], which acted as the enemy entrance, and a corrupted super computer, which acted as the exit. The path started at the portal and then split in two directions, that took on different twists and loops before merging after the small hill in the middle of the map and into the corrupted super computer that marked the end. There was also a separate path for [[Primordial Drakobloxxer]], which could not be seen. It started and ended at the same points, but took a different route. ==Interactive Map== {{Map:Containment}} ==Objective== At Wave 30, the "Defeat the Drakobloxxer" objective would be tasked to the players. This was because the final boss, [[Primordial Drakobloxxer]], did not follow the main path and instead moved around the map towards the exit, disregarding the main path, instead using its own path. Upon defeating it and completing the objective, the match would be triumphed and the final cutscene would play. ==Preset Loadouts== In the Easy difficulty, there were three preset loadouts: ''Vanguard'', ''Sentinel'' and ''Onyx Squad''. If not chosen after 30 seconds, the loadout chosen would be randomized. In the Hard difficulty, every player was given the [[Harvester]] if they did not have it equipped already. {{PresetLoadout |Name = Vanguard |Description = Provides close-quarters support, long-range towers, and units for a well-rounded loadout |Icon1 = DefaultBrawlerIconIG.png |SlotLink1 = Brawler |Icon2 = DefaultAcePilotIconIGJ24.png |SlotLink2 = Ace Pilot |Icon3 = DefaultMortarIconIG.png |SlotLink3 = Mortar |Icon4 = DefaultMercenaryBaseIconIG.png |SlotLink4 = Mercenary Base |Icon5 = DefaultJesterIconIG.png |SlotLink5 = Jester |Icon6 = DefaultHallowPunkIconIG.png |SlotLink6 = Hallow Punk }} {{PresetLoadout |Name = Sentinel |Description = Takes advantage of turrets, heavy air-support, and support towers to hold the line. |Icon1 = DefaultEngineerIconIG.png |SlotLink1 = Engineer |Icon2 = DefaultWardenIconIG.png |SlotLink2 = Warden |Icon3 = DefaultDJBoothIconIGAug2024.png |SlotLink3 = DJ Booth |Icon4 = DefaultPursuitIconIG.png |SlotLink4 = Pursuit |Icon5 = DefaultJesterIconIG.png |SlotLink5 = Jester |Icon6 = DefaultHallowPunkIconIG.png |SlotLink6 = Hallow Punk }} {{PresetLoadout |Name = Onyx Squad |Description = Includes some of the game's strongest yet most expensive towers. |Icon1 = GoldenCowboyIconIG.png |SlotLink1 = Golden Cowboy |Icon2 = DefaultElectroshockerIconIG.png |SlotLink2 = Electroshocker |Icon3 = DefaultRangerIconIG.png |SlotLink3 = Ranger |Icon4 = DefaultAccelIconIG.png |SlotLink4 = Accelerator |Icon5 = DefaultJesterIconIG.png |SlotLink5 = Jester |Icon6 = DefaultHallowPunkIconIG.png |SlotLink6 = Hallow Punk }} ==Rewards== The game calculated how many {{Exp|}} you received based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 100% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned was multiplied by 2x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplied any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts were additive. Rewards were calculated as: {| class="tds-table pad-10" style="text-align: center; margin:1em auto" !Coins Reward !EXP Reward |- ! colspan="2" |Easy |- |{{Coins|150}} ÷ (1 + [(30 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]^1.3) + {{Coins|50}} (Triumph Bonus) |{{Exp|80}} ÷ (1 + [(30 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]) |- ! colspan="2" |Hard |- |{{Coins|850}} ÷ (1 + [(30 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]^1.3) + {{Coins|150}} (Triumph Bonus) |{{Exp|250}} ÷ (1 + [(30 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]) |} Triumphing '''Containment''' could give out an additional reward, which could be any of the [[Hexscape Event]] consumables. These items were: *{{Color|Common}} (60%) **[[Turkey Leg]] ***Easy: 1-3 ***Hard: 2-4 **[[Pumpkin Bomb]] ***Easy: 1-2 ***Hard: 2-3 *{{Color|Uncommon}} (40%) **[[Sugar Rush (Consumable)|Sugar Rush]] ***Easy: 1-2 ***Hard: 2-3 ===Badges=== There were also a few badges which can be obtained when playing this map. These were: {{Badge |title = Night III Easy |image = NewNightIIIEasy.png |obtainable = No }} {{Badge |title = Night III |image = NewNightIIIHard.png |obtainable = No }} ==Wave Structure== '''Containment''' had two wave bonuses, based on the difficulty. In Easy, the wave bonus was calculated as: :{{Money|500}} + ([Waves Completed - 1] × {{Money|150}})^1.15 In Hard, the wave bonus was calculated as: :From Waves 1–12: :{{Money|500}} + ([Waves Completed - 1] × {{Money|150}})^1.15 :From Waves 13–25: :{{Money|500}} + ([Waves Completed - 1] × {{Money|150}})^1.2 :From Wave 26: :{{Money|500}} + ([Waves Completed - 1] × {{Money|150}})^1.25 On Wave 30, in the Easy difficulty every player was given {{Money|50,000}}, while in Hard, every player was given {{Money|500,000}}. Depending on player count, the wave bonus was reduced using multipliers. These multipliers are: {| class="wikitable align-center" style="width:50%; margin:1em auto" !Players !Reduction per Player !Total Reduction |- |Solo |0% |0% |- |Duo |10% (Easy)
5% (Hard) |20% (Easy)
10% (Hard) |- |Trio |1% |3% |} For example, on Wave 2 when difficulty is set to Hard, the wave bonus was {{Money|818.056992433}}, rounded down to {{Money|818}}. The full number was used in the equation. In duo, it was {{Money|736}} ({{Money|818.056992433}} × 0.9), while in trio, it was {{Money|793}} ({{Money|818.056992433}} × 0.97). The wave clear bonus appeared when every enemy from that wave was killed and no damage was dealt to the base health. It was 25% of the wave bonus in solo, while for duo, trio and quad it was 20%. Waves could not be skipped in '''Containment'''. The waves in '''Containment''' mode followed these timings: {| class="wikitable align-center" style="width:50%; margin:1em auto" !Waves !Wave Timer |- |1-4 |0:40 |- |5-9 |0:45 |- |10-14 |0:50 |- |15-19 |∞ |- |20 |∞ |- |21-24 |1:00 |- |25 |∞ |- |26-29 |1:05 |- |30 |∞ |} '''Bolded''' names indicate an enemy type's debut. ----

==Strategy== *The [[Cowboy]] and [[Golden Cowboy]] cash generation is halved in the Hard difficulty, though they are still great as they can defend the early waves while also generating income. *Towers such as the [[Golden Soldier]], [[Golden Scout]], [[Golden Crook Boss]], or even the [[Militant]] can fare quite well against early waves. *High DPS towers such as the [[Turret]], [[Ranger]], [[Golden Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]] and [[Engineer]] are needed to face the threat posed by this mode. *The [[Electroshocker]] is quite useful as it can mitigate the [[nimble]] attribute on enemies, stun crowds, provide AOE damage and is able to hit flying enemies. **It will also not conflict with other towers like the [[Pyromancer]] when stunning. *The [[Golden Pyromancer]] is great as it can easily deal with large hordes of enemies while also reducing their defense. **The [[Pyromancer]] is also usable here, though it may not be as effective in dealing with crowds. *In the Hard difficulty, you will have a sixth tower slot for the [[Harvester]], you can use this tower for its thorns ability, which can damage multiple enemies and slow them down. **It is not recommended to bring your own [[Harvester]] for this reason, as you will waste a spot for other necessary towers. *Support towers like the [[DJ Booth]] and [[Commander]] are essential to boost your towers. *The [[Medic]] is especially useful as [[Primordial Drakobloxxer]] will have multiple of AOE stun abilities, making it quite useful as it can remove stuns from towers. *As [[Primordial Drakobloxxer]] does not follow the normal path and instead circles around the map a couple times before it heads to the exit, towers with more so large range and high DPS such as the [[Turret]] and [[Ranger]] are recommended to constantly deal damage to it. **Placing towers near the middle of the map is also recommended so that all towers are able to hit it without getting out of range. **The [[DJ Booth]] can also be quite useful as it can boost the range of your towers. *This map is good for grinding {{CandyCorns|Candy Corn}}, as it gives the most {{CandyCorns|Candy Corn}} per match than every other mode.
